label: Remote MCP Server
title: Remote MCP Server
subtitle: Wraps a remote MCP server (HTTP or Server-Sent Events) and exposes its tools to agents. Used for cloud-hosted MCP integrations.
whenToUse: Used automatically when you have connected a remote MCP integration. The tools from the remote server appear as agent capabilities.

methods.name: (dynamic)
methods.description: Methods are determined by the remote MCP server's tool manifest and vary per server.

mediaCaption: A remote MCP server tool call showing the server URL, the method invoked, and the response
